views.rationale: The company's forward-looking statements regarding the potential future impact of macroeconomic conditions and tariffs on its business and results of operations suggest a cautious outlook.
The company's investment portfolio and debt are exposed to interest rate risk, with the fair value of long-term debt fluctuating with movements in interest rates.

The commercial aircraft market and airline industry remain extremely competitive, with intense pressures on pricing and other competitive factors, and we expect these pressures to continue or intensify in the coming years.

Net interest income increased $4.0 billion to $60.1 billion in 2025 compared to 2024, driven by higher net interest income related to Global Markets activity, fixed-asset repricing, and deposit and loan growth.
Sales and revenues for 2025 were $67.589 billion, an increase of 10.3% compared to 2024, but the company's MD&A does not provide specific guidance on future growth.
Other components of net periodic benefit costs increased in 2025 primarily due to higher settlement and curtailment losses, partially offset by higher expected return on plan assets.
Google's 2025 results compared to 2024 results will be discussed in Item 7 of the 2024 Annual Report on Form 10-K.
GS's commercial real estate exposure was $44,594 million as of December 2025.
